text:
maya-partners: Quick sync request StratusRack marketplace listing + GridWorks SI integration. Need to confirm embargo window, staging tenant IDs, and who owns the UTM/tracking. Anyone free for a short sprint?

pranav-marketing: I can take lead on GTM. Proposed embargo: Jun 2 11:00 PDT. We need final hero + 800x450 screenshot and one hero gif 72h before. Also want the social cadence mapped (X, LinkedIn, partners).

ashley-engineering: From infra side we need a 3hr warm window for model warmup and cache priming. Can do Jun 1 01:00-04:00 UTC. Will need exact model bundle size and a list of endpoints to route.

jorge-ops: Staging reservation request created by deploy-bot: staging-slot-1809 1: https://infra.redwood/staging/1809

deploy-bot: reservation created: staging-slot-1809 d Jun 1 01:00-04:00 UTC d tenant hold enabled.

nora-legal: Please upload StratusRack logo pack + trademark usage doc and GridWorks quote approvals. Legal needs 48h to review any partner-provided copy. No use of partner logos in press until signoff.

tina-cs: Demo team will need two sandbox tenants and sample telemetry from GridWorks. Also want to rehearse a webinar flow w/ partner (10 min live demo + 15 min Q&A). Can GridWorks commit to a 30min dry run?

maya-partners: GridWorks confirmed dry run slot on May 29 16:00 PT. They will provide sample telemetry dumps by May 25.

pranav-marketing: Action items I'll take: PR draft, social calendar, landing copy + UTM mapping. Need partner quote by May 24 EOD.

ashley-engineering: For perf we will validate using quantized-8bit bundle, seq=2048 and batch [1,2,4]. Preliminary estimate: reserve 6xA40-equivalent for 30m ramp, then scale down.

jorge-ops: Tenant provisioning - I can provision once I have tenant slugs. Need those by May 26 to hit Jun 1 reservation.

nora-legal: Reminder: any partner-sourced testimonial needs partner-signed release. Upload to GDrive -> Legal/partners/stratus_grid.

tina-cs: I'll draft demo scripts: happy-path query, failure handling, and partner-fallback. Will post in this thread as snippets.

pranav-marketing: We also need analytics pixel + partner UTM params. @ashley-engineering can you confirm landing supports query params and server-side tracking?

ashley-engineering: Landing supports server-side UTM capture and we can send referrer to analytics pipeline. I need tracking schema by May 28.

maya-partners: TL;DR action list:
- By May 24 EOD: StratusRack quote + logo pack  owner: partner (via maya)
- By May 25: GridWorks sample telemetry  owner: GridWorks/SI
- By May 26: Tenant slugs to Jorge for provisioning  owner: tina-cs / maya
- By May 28: Tracking schema and analytics requirements  owner: ashley-eng
- May 29 16:00 PT: Partner dry run (GridWorks)  owner: tina-cs
- Jun 1 01:00-04:00 UTC: Staging warm & smoke  owner: ashley-eng + jorge-ops
- Jun 2 11:00 PDT: Embargo lift / publish (PR + landing + social)  owner: pranav-marketing

jorge-ops: I'll create a short provisioning checklist and paste it here in next msg.

tina-cs: Webinar ops note  can we add a partner CTA to the landing that routes to partner co-demo signups? We need a form+UTM.

pranav-marketing: Yes, CTA -> /partners/stratus-signup?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=stratus_grid_launch. Will add to creative brief.

nora-legal: All good on process. Once assets are in GDrive I'll fast-track the logo and quote approvals.

maya-partners: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll lock these owners and schedule a 20min preflight on May 31 10:00 PT to run checklist.

ashley-engineering: Works for eng.

pranav-marketing: Works for marketing.

jorge-ops: I'll post provisioning checklist below after a quick polish.

tina-cs: I'll post demo scripts tomorrow.

maya-partners: Closing loop  will create calendar invite and GDrive folder. Ping here for anything urgent.
